title: The blow-up of the cubic fourfold along eight planes is Fano
summary: We prove that the blow-up Z_m of a smooth cubic fourfold along m 6 that are not a product of surfaces. Complementary to this result, we show that a smooth cubic fourfold as above exists. Moreover, we study the birational geometry of Z_m and show that it corresponds exactly to that of a smooth del Pezzo surfaces S_m, obtained as the blow-up of P^2 along m <= 8 points in general position.
